title: Configure the restartable SENTINEL/MIFUNE session and its CYPHER analysis
summary: Configure the restartable SENTINEL/MIFUNE session and its CYPHER analysis. The contract registers the existing owner API and does not certify the accuracy of a particular molecular calculation.
gates: Confirm molecular identities before constructing the simulation request
Sampling and propagation are delegated to SENTINEL or MIFUNE; CYPHER owns reduction
Persist the session and report the scientific engines and boundary acknowledgement
coordinate_policy: Preserve the ordered molecular identity, isotope masses, coordinate frame and declared owner representation; no geometry remapping or method substitution is implicit.
backend_policy: The scientific owner validates the inputs and numerical controls. Any missing electronic-structure acquisition uses the separately authorized calculation gateway; registration alone launches nothing.
